title: Tiny, cute alarm clock
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='38' y='78' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e05a3a'/>
  <rect x='56' y='78' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e05a3a'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='92' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ff8a5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='92' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ff8a5c'/>
  <!-- bell tops -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='24' r='9' fill='#ffd54a'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='24' r='9' fill='#ffd54a'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='24' r='5' fill='#ffb300'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='24' r='5' fill='#ffb300'/>
  <!-- hammer -->
  <rect x='47' y='10' width='6' height='10' rx='3' fill='#ff8a5c'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='5' fill='#ff8a5c'/>
  <!-- clock body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='35' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='30' fill='#fff6d6'/>
  <!-- inner ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='25' fill='none' stroke='#ffd54a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- tick marks -->
  <rect x='49' y='26' width='2' height='5' rx='1' fill='#e05a3a'/>
  <rect x='49' y='69' width='2' height='5' rx='1' fill='#e05a3a'/>
  <rect x='26' y='49' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#e05a3a'/>
  <rect x='69' y='49' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#e05a3a'/>
  <!-- hands -->
  <rect x='49' y='34' width='3' height='18' rx='1.5' fill='#e05a3a'/>
  <rect x='50' y='48' width='16' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#e05a3a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ff8a5c'/>
  <!-- cute face -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='42' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='42' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='41' rx='1.2' ry='1.5' fill='#fff'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='41' rx='1.2' ry='1.5' fill='#fff'/>
  <path d='M42 56 Q50 62 58 56' fill='none' stroke='#3a2a1a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='52' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9e9e' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='52' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9e9e' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
